# Novaflow — Company Context

- **What it is:** B2B SaaS platform for **workflow automation and data pipelines** aimed at
  mid-market enterprises. Customers build automated workflows that move and transform data
  between their internal systems.
- **Stage / size:** Series C; ~$74M ARR; ~380 employees; ~1,900 customers; HQ in Austin with a
  remote-first engineering org.
- **Business model:** seat + usage (per pipeline-run) hybrid pricing; enterprise contracts carry
  a **99.95% uptime SLA** and security commitments.
- **Go-to-market:** product-led signups feeding an enterprise sales motion led by
  [Sofia Alvarez](../people/sofia-alvarez.md).
- **Board:** chaired by [Eleanor Vance](../people/eleanor-vance.md) (Meridian Ventures).
- **Strategic bets (2026 H2):** platform re-architecture (Atlas), reliability (Meridian),
  SOC 2 (Sentinel), data pipelines (Cascade), and the confidential
  [Falcon](../projects/falcon.md) transaction.
- **Competitive note:** partner [Datalytix](../people/helena-braun.md) both integrates with and
  partially overlaps Novaflow — manage information sharing accordingly.
